coordinateSystem: All crop, anchor, muzzle and barrel measurements use source pixels. crop is atlas-global [x,y,w,h]. anchor, muzzle and barrelFace are crop-local [x,y]. Draw at (worldX-anchor.x*unit, footY-anchor.y*unit). Muzzle world offset is (muzzle-anchor)*unit, then apply the same actor transform. No per-frame resizing.

recommendedPlayback.note: Frame 2 has a small raised-chin recoil; avoid very high-frequency full-pose switching. Convey bullet speed with barrel detail, joint recoil and tracers. Boots remain planted.

provenance.processing: Image-generation art; lossless WebP format conversion only. No hand-painted or programmatic pixel edits. Alpha crop measured at >20; common physical boot baseline measured at >128.
provenance.alpha: Fully transparent empty regions; sub-20 alpha edge noise is excluded by measured crops.
